P01.rationale: Two figures fill nearly the entire page as a full-bleed portrait, serving as a dominant human anchor.

P05.rationale: No case study columns or named client portrait frames are present on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logos, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is visible anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: No giant ghost numerals or oversized decorative quote glyphs are used as typographic elements.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, before/after comparisons, charts, or cost-math figures are present.

P12.rationale: The layout is a single full-bleed photo with one text line — visually striking but editorially sparse with no layered content zones.

P13.rationale: The real office environment and herringbone floor provide a contextual atmospheric background rather than flat blankness.

P14.rationale: A dark gradient scrim is applied at the bottom of the photo, keeping the white text legible against the busy background.

P16.rationale: No device, product mockup, phone, laptop, or book is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The handshake-in-office setting is somewhat generic but the branded signage on the wall adds some specificity.

N08.rationale: The page is mostly filled by the photo; the only sparse area is the upper portion of the image which is intentional composition rather than dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: The headline text sits directly over the busy lower portion of the photo; while a scrim helps, the background detail behind the text is still quite active and creates some tension.
